cards.name: Duelist's Heritage
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more creatures attack, you may have target attacking creature gain double strike until end of turn.

rulings.comment: The ability of Duelist's Heritage triggers whenever any player attacks with one or more creatures, not just when you do. You know which players and planeswalkers the creatures are attacking before you choose the target creature.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
